1.author: dana-r
1.title: Add shipment refunds
1.body:
## Refunds

Adds refund support for shipments.

- `POST /shipments/{id}/refund` refunds the full charge, or a partial `amount`. The amount is validated, so a shipment can never be refunded for more than it was charged.
- `GET /customers/{id}/refunds` lists a customer's refunds, optionally filtered by shipment status.
- The refund endpoint is idempotent: a retry with the same `Idempotency-Key` returns the original refund and never refunds twice.
- Voids the label with the carrier, with retries.
- The refund amount calculation sits behind a `RefundStrategy` so we can add other policies later.

Also fixes an off-by-one in shipment pagination where the shipment at the cursor was skipped.

No behaviour change to existing endpoints otherwise. Tests added.

2.author: dana-r
2.title: Cap the listing page size at 100
2.body:
`GET /customers/{id}/shipments` accepted any positive `limit`, so one request could ask for a customer's whole history.

This caps `limit` at 100 in `parse_limit`. A larger value is rejected with a 422, the same way the other invalid values are. The default stays 20.

Tests cover the boundary (100 passes, 101 fails) and the endpoint response. README updated.
